scope: Selected relocation/displacement branches and CBE casualty retirement call path; not whole source parity.
referenceIntent: Move only current driver/commander using actor doMove, preserving group membership. Relocation waits in five-second sleeps until within 120m or platform death; selected branch has no finite timeout or current-task/crew handover acknowledgement. Displacement re-reads crew after firing sleep. Do not copy that unbounded wait or treat a replacement seat as continuation authority.

verifiedGap.trigger: After movement admission, original driver/effective commander is lost or replaced, or another control predicate fails.
path: CrewMoveStep _control fails and calls _finish without retired=true except before ISSUE movement.
_finish publishes UNRESOLVED and retains group reference and local movement reservation.
Discover calls CrewMoveRetire when private worker is no longer live.
CrewMoveRetire only admits ISSUE/REQUESTED/MOVING/HOLD/STOPPING/RETURNING; UNRESOLVED cannot enter retirement.
OwnershipLease acquisition refuses any nonempty ArtilleryCrew_Reference even after lease expiration; CrewMoveStart also refuses it.
verifiedGap.consequence: Automatic subsequent CBE movement acquisition for this group remains refused. This is a deliberate fail-closed authority boundary with an unfinished recovery path, not verified physical quiescence.

requiredImplementation: Separate retired/dead original actors from live original native writers. Admit a finite owner/epoch/serial-scoped observation and retirement path for surviving original selected crew, with no automatic command to replacement crew or unrelated infantry. Release only on current native-task supersession or positively observed original writer retirement. Preserve original cleanup deadline; no timer-only success, force seating, group split or blanket reference deletion. Determine an explicit terminal disposition for destroyed/deleted platforms while preserving original actor authority.
validation: Static call-path inspection only. No runtime change, new tests, build rerun, physical claim or percentage increase. Audit runs remain paused.
